title: fix(spec,plugin-webhooks)!: retire the GET webhook method and park stored GET subscriptions with a visible reason
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #34098

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `git grep` of `skills/` finds no webhook `method` value taught anywhere, so no page names `GET` as a webhook method.

> **BREAKING** — a webhook can no longer be authored with `method: 'GET'`, on either surface: `WebhookSchema.method` (`@objectstack/spec/automation`) and the `sys_webhook` `method` select (`@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`). A row already stored with `get` is parked with a visible reason, never converted. Migration: set the method to `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE`. ADR-0087 D3 entry `webhook-method-get-retired`; no D2 conversion exists.

Maintainer ruling (6902187601), quoted as tapped: 「A 从契约中移除 GET」 — spec 枚举和 sys_webhook 下拉都去掉 GET，属破坏性变更；已存的 GET 行停用并写明原因，不自动改成 POST。

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Webhook 的请求方法去掉 GET（spec 枚举和 Setup 下拉两处）；已经存成 GET 的 Webhook 不再投递，每个事件记一条带原因的 dead 投递记录。
- 为什么改：每次投递都把事件放在请求正文里，GET 请求没有正文，所以 GET Webhook 从来没有成功送达过一次。
- 风险与回滚：破坏性变更，只影响写了 GET 的 Webhook（仓库内没有）；已存的 GET 行不会被改成别的方法。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/auto-enqueuer.ts`（`parseRow` 里的停用分支与刷新循环跳过凭据），`packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.zod.ts`（枚举与提示文案），`.changeset/34098-webhook-method-get-retired.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/webhook-get-retired-34098.test.ts`，预期 7 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（需一次 spec 契约面的 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核）。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.zod.ts`): `method` is `enumWithRetiredValues(['POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE'], { GET: … })`, default `POST` unchanged. `method: 'GET'` fails parse with a prescription naming the four methods; any other unknown value keeps zod's own message. `HEAD` was never in the enum and is not mentioned.
- **D3 entry** (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.webhook-method-get-retired.ts`): the upgrade-guide entry. No D2 conversion: converting GET would start sending another method to an endpoint configured for GET.
- **Select** (`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts`): four options. The record validator now refuses an insert or update with `method: 'get'` (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, a field error `invalid_option` on `method`). The `options.get` leaf and its source hash leave all eleven locale bundles (regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=webhooks`; the diff is 21 deletions only).
- **Park** (`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/auto-enqueuer.ts`): `parseRow` sets `parkedReason` when the stored method is retired. The refresh loop then skips credential resolution for that row (a parked subscription carries no secret and no header map), and `projectDeclared` does the same for a declared webhook handed in by a reader that skipped the schema. Each matched event goes through the existing #8069 path to `recordUndeliverable()`: one `dead` row, 0 attempts, no signature, reason `[VALIDATION_ERROR/400] webhook 'NAME' is stored with HTTP method GET … Fix: edit the webhook and set its method to POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE …`. Said once at `error`. Parked events never call `enqueue`, so the outbox's bodyless-GET refusal from #34067 is not reached. The stored method is never rewritten.
- **Declared webhooks**: `DeclaredWebhookSource.parseItem` parses through `WebhookSchema`, so a declared GET is now refused there with the existing "declared webhook failed validation — not dispatched" warning and never reaches the dispatcher. `declared-webhooks.ts` is unchanged.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` method row without GET, plus a "Stored GET webhooks are parked" note; `content/docs/references/automation/webhook.mdx` regenerated by `gen:docs`.

Sequencing: built after PR #34067 (#33895) merged (`0d1443d0` on main, merged into this branch). Reviewer note N5 on #34067: until this PR lands, a GET webhook on main leaves only a lost-event log line and no delivery row, so this PR should ship in the same release as #34067.

## Tests

New file `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/webhook-get-retired-34098.test.ts`, on a real `SqlDriver` (SQLite) under a real `ObjectQL`, with `SqlHttpOutbox`, `MessagingService` and `HttpDispatcher`:

- save door: insert with `get` refused `VALIDATION_FAILED` (the engine's `ValidationError`; REST maps it to 400) with `invalid_option` on `method`, nothing stored; update to `get` refused, stored method still `post`; the four methods save; the select offers exactly four.
- stored GET row (H1, H3): one `dead` row per event with 0 attempts, no signature, `method: GET` and the reason; a dispatcher tick sends nothing; `redeliverHttp` refused `DELIVERY_NEVER_SENT`; the park is reported once at `error` with `code`/`status`/`method` in meta; the stored method reads `get` through the driver and the engine.
- CONTROL (H2): a POST row delivers one POST carrying the envelope.
- declared GET: refused at parse by `DeclaredWebhookSource`; one handed in past the schema is parked with no credentials on the row.

Spec side, in the existing `packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.test.ts`: the four methods parse; `GET` is refused with `invalid_value` at `['method']` and the prescription's first sentence; `TRACE` keeps zod's message.

## Acceptance notes

- PM hypotheses: H1 holds (one dead row per event, reason present, no signature, fetch not called). H2 holds (the POST control delivers; healthy rows take the unchanged path). H3 holds (the method reads `get` after the park).
- The park reason carries the standard-catalog pair `[VALIDATION_ERROR/400]`, the pair `webhook-legacy-cleartext.ts` carries on its own delivery door; the save door's `VALIDATION_FAILED` is the engine record validator's own answer. A first cut stamped `VALIDATION_FAILED` in plugin-webhooks and `check:error-code-provenance` refused it (a registered code with no provenance row under the plugin's owner key); the standard-catalog member needs no ledger row, so no new error code and no ledger edit.
- The spec's generated ratchets moved nothing: `check:generated` reports all 14 up to date and the diff touches nothing under `api-surface/`, `authorable-surface/` or `json-schema.manifest/`, as an enum-value narrowing is expected to (the def, its exports and its key are unchanged); only the generated reference page shows the four values.

## Verification

Final head `b61479ce` (main merged at `8ab601e3`, #34067 included). Each reading names its head. At open, `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main `7be32d39` is clean and none of the 27 newer main commits touches a file in this diff; main was not merged again so the battery stays on the final head.

<details><summary>Ablations at `4ff9df50` (each restored through a trap, git diff HEAD empty, HEAD blob hashes matched)</summary>

- Park removed (`retiredMethodParkReason` returns undefined): 2 failed / 5 passed — `expected 'pending' to be 'dead'` for the stored GET row and for the declared GET past the schema.
- GET put back in the select: 3 failed / 4 passed — `expected undefined to be defined` (insert admitted), `expected undefined to match object { code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' }` (update admitted), the options list.
- Spec enum back to `z.enum(['GET', …])`: 1 failed / 24 passed — `expected true to be false` (GET parsed).

</details>

- `b61479ce`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks test` 26 files, 314 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `8ab601e3`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` 843 files, 26983 passed, 1 todo; `typecheck` exit 0. Spec `test:repo` is left to CI's Test Core.
- `8ab601e3`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` all 14 artifacts up to date.
- `8ab601e3`, direct dependents of plugin-webhooks: `@objectstack/verify` test 52 files, 439 passed; http-conformance's two webhook files 13 passed; cli `--project unit` on its webhook-touching files 4 files, 176 passed (narrowed to the files that name webhooks; the full cli suites are CI's). Spec's dependents are CI's.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, closure built), final head `b61479ce`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 469 passed / 3 skipped (472), Tests 3974 passed / 42 skipped (4016), no failure. The same counts at `69f9d19c`.

NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met, CI runs them): `check:skill-examples` (needs `@objectstack/client-react` built), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package built). `--ran` reconciliation: 118 derived, 116 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm lint` exit 0. `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration` (registered `webhook-method-get-retired`, new here), `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:error-code-casing`: exit 0 on this body and changeset.
